newsitem.title: FRANCE: DHL opens new French centre, plans 8 by end '97.
newsitem.headline: DHL opens new French centre, plans 8 by end '97.

text.p: The French unit of DHL Worldwide Express said it had opened a new operating centre at Trappes to handle shipments in the southern suburbs of Paris.
The two million france Trappes centre near Versailles, comprises 600 sq m of warehousing and 200 sq m of offices, the express distribution operator added.
"We now have 23 centres in France and plan to invest 18 million francs in opening a further seven by end 1997, creating 54 jobs."
DHL France had also opened new facilities at its existing Paris-Opera centre in the centre of the capital. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
